# ngrok documentation: Start

> Every page in the Start section of the ngrok docs (4 pages). Each link points to the page's Markdown version.

## Start Here

- [Get Started with ngrok](https://ngrok.com/docs/start.md): ngrok helps you run production traffic, call AI models, and build and test on your machine. Pick the quickstart for the job you need to get done.
- [What is ngrok?](https://ngrok.com/docs/about/index.md): ngrok is developer infrastructure that routes and secures traffic to your apps, APIs, and AI models, wherever they run.

## Help

- [FAQ](https://ngrok.com/docs/faq/index.md): Frequently asked questions about ngrok including status page, payment methods, security, and platform features.
- [Glossary of Terms](https://ngrok.com/docs/glossary.md): A glossary of technical terms used in ngrok's documentation.
